title: God of Mercy, Hear Our Prayer
description: God of Mercy, Hear Our Prayer in Tonic Solfa to INNOCENTS, doh is D: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 738 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “Prayer for Children”, where the book credits them to Campbell's Collection.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Sevens (7.7.7.7), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to INNOCENTS; any other Sevens tune fits them as well.
underlay: God of mer-cy, hear our prayer For the child-ren thou hast given; Let them all thy bless-ings share Grace on earth and bliss in heaven.

lines: God of mercy, hear our prayer
For the children thou hast given;
Let them all thy blessings share —
Grace on earth and bliss in heaven.
In the morning of their days
May their hearts be drawn to thee;
Let them learn to lisp thy praise
When we see their passions rise,
Then to thee we lift our eyes,
That their hearts may be renewed.
For this mercy, Lord, we cry;
While on thee our souls rely,
Hear our prayer — in mercy hear.

licence: Public domain: anonymous words in print by 1853.
credits: Words anonymous, public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to INNOCENTS by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
